name: Program - Summing Amplifier

pins.signal: NORMALLY OPERATING AT UNITY GAIN WHEREAS IN
pins.quote: When used as summing amplifier, the M4SOB is normally operating at unity gain, whereas in the program amplifier mode the gain may be adjusted anywhere between 24 and 40 dB Al gain changes are achieved by external resistance strapping On pins 9 , 10 and 11 on the module connector, affecting the feedb
